description: This file contains abstract test classes and helper structures for testing serialization and copying functionalities within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace. It defines test classes for copying and field encoding, along with utility types for buffer manipulation, all intended to be subclassed for concrete test implementations.

classes.name: CopierTester`2
classes.description: Abstract base class designed to test deep copier implementations for a specific value type.

classes.name: FieldCodecTester`2
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing field codecs that serialize and deserialize values.

classes.name: ValueTypeFieldCodecTester`2
classes.description: Specialized test class for value type field codecs, includes specific tests for value serialization.

classes.name: IOutputBuffer
classes.description: Interface for buffer providers used during serialization, providing read-only sequences.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceHelper
classes.description: Utility static class for working with ReadOnlySequence, including batching and conversion methods.

classes.name: TestBufferWriterStruct
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for testing purposes, providing in-memory buffer manipulation.

classes.name: TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter
classes.description: A class implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for multi-segment buffer testing scenarios.
